name: AnchorNav
label: Anchor nav
description: An on-page list of anchor links that tracks the reader's position and jumps between sections.

props.name: items
props.description: The on-page sections to list, in document order

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual form: `list` renders the inline "On this page" rail; `floating` collapses to a stack of short lines that expands into a panel on hover, keyboard focus, or tap, so it can ride a page edge without taking column width

props.name: title
props.description:
Header text above the list; pass an empty string to render no header.
Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which AnchorNav does not expose.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon beside the header — Material Symbol name (string) or custom element (ReactNode); pass an empty string for none

props.name: activeId
props.description: Controlled active item id — set it to drive the highlight yourself and skip scroll tracking

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Fires when the tracked (or clicked) active item changes

props.name: offset
props.description: Distance in px from the viewport top at which a section counts as current, e.g. a sticky header's height
